# REX Medical Complex

> Child development and therapy centre in Allama Iqbal Town, Lahore, offering speech and language therapy, ABA therapy, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, play therapy and specialist consultations.

- Address: 91 A, College Block, Allama Iqbal Town, Lahore, Pakistan

## Services

- [Services](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services): Explore speech, ABA, occupational, physiotherapy, play therapy and specialist consultations for children at REX Medical Complex, Lahore.
- [Speech Therapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/speech-therapy): Speech and language therapy for speech delay, stammering and communication difficulties in children. Qualified speech pathologists in Lahore.
- [ABA Therapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/behavior-therapy): Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children with autism and behavioural challenges at REX Medical Complex, Allama Iqbal Town, Lahore.
- [Occupational Therapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/occupational-therapy): Paediatric occupational therapy and sensory integration to build motor, self-care and sensory-processing skills. Book a free consultation in Lahore.
- [Physiotherapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/physiotherapy): Physiotherapy at REX Medical Complex, Lahore, supporting mobility, balance, strength and coordination. Book a consultation with our team.
- [Sensory Integration Therapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/sensory-therapy): Sensory integration therapy for children who over- or under-respond to sound, touch and movement, at REX Medical Complex, Lahore.
- [Play Therapy](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/play-therapy): Play therapy that helps children express feelings, build confidence and develop social skills, at REX Medical Complex, Lahore.
- [Specialist Consultations](https://rexmedcomplex.com/services/specialist-consultations): Consult experienced specialist doctors at REX Medical Complex, Allama Iqbal Town, Lahore. Book your appointment online or on WhatsApp.
